title: Pokernow Metric1 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: BoardGameGeek plays (`bgg:play`), Poker Now sessions (`pokernow:session`), Bridge Base Online boards (`bridgebase:board`), and Lichess tournament rounds (`lichess:tournament`).
app: BoardGameGeek play logs, Poker Now session exports, Bridge Base Online boards, and Lichess tournament data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pokernow:metric1
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for pokernow metric1 (1) data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate pokernow metric1 (1) events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It catches how your pokernow metric1 (1) activity added up each month instead of day by day.
